page.notes: Printed page number is partly unclear: read as 306 with a doubtful final digit. The running head contains a doubtful symbol after "C." (read as 3). The small mark at the lower left beside "non æ-" is not text and is left out. The catchword "rum-" is taken from the lower right and is the start of the next page's word "ærum".
